note: San Marino used the Italian lira before the euro
Monaco used the French franc before the euro
World Bank data for Bulgaria are already in euros for all years (GDP and PPP); the official exchange rate is published in leva and is converted here
World Bank data for Venezuela are in the bolivar of October 2021; official exchange rates end in 2017
Official exchange rates for Turkmenistan end in 2001

Zimbabwe changed currency many times (redenominations of the Zimbabwe dollar in 2006, 2008 and 2009, US dollars from 2009 to 2019, the RTGS/Zimbabwe dollar from 2019 and ZiG from 2024); World Bank values before 2009 are not reliable and official and alternative rates differ widely
Ecuador adopted the US dollar in 2000; World Bank data are in US dollars for all years. Amounts in sucres are converted at each year's official rate
El Salvador adopted the US dollar in 2001; World Bank data are in US dollars for all years. Amounts in colones are converted at each year's official rate
Liberia's national accounts are in US dollars (both currencies circulate). Amounts in Liberian dollars are converted at each year's official rate
West Bank and Gaza's national accounts are in US dollars and there is no official exchange rate. Amounts in shekels are converted at Israel's official rate for the year
The balboa is fixed at 1 per US dollar and US notes circulate; PAB and USD amounts are the same
The Bahamian dollar is fixed at 1 per US dollar
The Bermudian dollar is fixed at 1 per US dollar
